fields.title: Quantitative Gaussian Simplex Stability at Small Positive Correlations
fields.abstract: For each fixed number of cells $k\ge2$, we prove that the central regular-simplex partition maximizes Gaussian noise stability among equal-measure measurable $k$-cell partitions at sufficiently small positive correlations $\rho$ in dimensions $d\ge k-1$. The noise stability deficit is bounded below by a positive constant times $\rho$ times the square of the summed Gaussian symmetric differences from the closest simplex partition. Both the constant and the correlation threshold are independent of the ambient dimension. Zhang's first-moment theorem localizes near maximizers. To prove the positive-correlation bound, we normalize arbitrary label changes by their exact loss against the simplex's Ornstein--Uhlenbeck scores. A Gaussian covariance estimate on the facets bounds the limiting first-moment interaction, and a Hermite expansion controls all remaining directions uniformly in the dimension.
